title: Wisconsin’s $1.1M Barbie Dream House goes under contract
summary_full: In Hudson, Wisconsin, a charming pink Victorian house constructed in 1900 has made a remarkable transformation from its original Goth style. Recently listed at $1.1 million, the property is now under contract. Featuring seven bedrooms and four bathrooms, the home boasts inviting spaces for gatherings and rentals. The creative homeowner painted it pink and opened it up for various uses, showcasing its versatility.
